name: jj-concurrent
description: Concurrent multi-agent orchestration on Jujutsu (jj) workspaces: the jj-delegate mechanism, the jj-workspace-worker agent, the jj-absorb amend-after-review step (preview with jj absorb --dry-run, distribute working-copy hunks into their downstack commits, and report where each landed), the jj-pr push-and-PR step (push a bookmark then create-or-update its GitHub PR via gh), the jj-stacked-pr step (open/update a stack of based GitHub PRs from a stitched linear jj stack), plus snapshot and guard hooks.
